module TopModule (
    input  clk,
    input  reset,
    input  slowena,
    output logic [3:0] q
);

    always_ff @(posedge clk) begin
        if (reset) begin
            q <= 4'b0000;
        end else if (slowena) begin
            if (q == 4'b1001) begin  // 9 in binary
                q <= 4'b0000;       // wrap around to 0
            end else begin
                q <= q + 1;
            end
        end
        // If slowena is low, q retains its current value (no increment)
    end

endmodule
